# Skinvestments

> Skinvestments helps CS2 players track a skin portfolio with valuations, price history, and alerts on web and mobile.

## Product

- [Home](https://skinvestments.app/): CS2 portfolio tracker overview.
- [Features](https://skinvestments.app/features): Inventory value, charts, drops, multi-market pricing.
- [CS2 Skin Tracker](https://skinvestments.app/cs2-skin-tracker): Dedicated landing for CS2 / CSGO skin tracker intent.
- [Pricing](https://skinvestments.app/pricing): Free Starter and paid plans.
- [Blog](https://skinvestments.app/blog): Guides on CS2 inventory tracking and pricing.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/skinvestments-cs2-investments/id6757268598): iOS app.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.steamvestments): Android app.
